We report empirical results for the Oracle task of the GuessWhat?! benchmark (de Vries et al., 2017) and for the history dependent subset GWHist described in Section 3. We evaluate the RuD-augmented models and compare them with their respective RuD-less baselines.

guideline: Look at the picture and the candidate question without looking at the dialog history. Answer the question with "yes", "maybe yes", "maybe no", "no" or "I don't know". Compare to the answer in the corpus that the person gave to that question considering the dialog history. If the answers do not coincide, mark the question as history dependent.
